scope: Seven saved static-reader stages from global-load boundary through numeric140420; workspace files only
limitations: Original identity, closure and non-execution claims are verified against saved records; this inventory does not reopen original modules or replay readers.
Semantic byte totals sum actual new reads reported per stage, excluding reused cache and whole-file hashing; within-round unique offsets and repeated bytes are listed separately.
Current documents are a point-in-time snapshot and can receive later authorized appends; rehash candidates before sealing.
The earlier15-file checkpoint copies remain sealed; current live docs are compared explicitly and are not all presumed unchanged.
No full logical/runtime compatibility, native execution, build or test acceptance is asserted.
This inventory lists itself by path only to avoid a self-referential hash; the enclosing checkpoint should record its final SHA256.
